summary: Note: the review request reached me truncated, so I inferred the scope from git diff fde8eb4..d7a4fa6. Two features under test: (1) Liquidaciones, owner payment from a gross amount with automatic commission retention: montoBruto/descuentaComision, comisionPctEfectivo, cap at the pending commission with comisionWarning, new comisionRetenida/comisionPendiente fields, synthetic movement rows, live preview; (2) the 'Liquidación al propietario' PDF no longer shows the guest's phone/DNI and now has a gross/commission/net table per payment. Backend: 49/49 passing (8 existing comision_retenida tests, 11 new iter100 edge-case tests, 30 regression tests for owner payments and pending liquidations). Frontend: the full admin E2E flow on /veraos/liquidaciones passed (preview, checkbox toggle, save, chip, sub-totals, cap warning, 'Liquidación completa', synthetic rows have no delete button, Historial tab, PDF download, delete payment reverts). The core feature works. Two logic/UX gaps found: overpayment is accepted silently, and pending commission is inconsistent when payments are recorded without the discount.

minor.issue: No overpayment guard. On a reservation with neto 1,325,940, a second payment of gross 1,000,000 was accepted: totalPagadoPropietario 1,517,440, so the owner was overpaid by 191,500. The only warning returned was the commission-cap one, and saldo clamps to 0. A bare gross 900,000 on a 410,000-net reservation was also accepted (810,000 recorded). Suggest a 400 error or an 'excede el saldo' warning when the neto exceeds saldoLiquidacion.

comisionPendiente is derived only from pagos[].comisionRetenida. Payments without the discount, and legacy payments (old 'monto' was already net, with no comisionRetenida), leave comisionPendiente = full commission even when estadoLiquidacion='pagado'. Reproduced: paid 1,325,940 with the discount unchecked, giving 'Liquidación completa' plus 'Retenida $0 · Pendiente $291.060', a 'Comisión pendiente $291.060' row, and the same text in the PDF. Suggest comisionPendiente = 0 (or treat it as retained) once the saldo is 0, or infer retention for legacy/non-discount payments.
The commission cap is a non-atomic read-then-$push. In my 6-way parallel test the cap held (90,000 = total), but nothing enforces it under true concurrency. Low risk; consider a conditional update.

minor.endpoint: rentals_pdf.py 'Emitido el' / auto commission movement date
minor.issue: Dates use UTC while the default payment date uses _hoy_ar(). After 21:00 AR the PDF shows 'Emitido 18/11' and commission dated 18/11, but the payments are dated 17/11. Pre-existing; use the AR timezone consistently.

integration_issues.issue: The preview warns about the commission cap but not about the net exceeding 'Falta'. The UI lets the user overpay the owner with no warning (see backend minor).
The chip label says '$X neto' whenever montoBruto is set, even when descuentaComision=false (nothing was deducted). Show 'neto' only when commission was retained.

issues: The gross input placeholder 'Monto cobrado al huésped (bruto)' is truncated to 'Monto cobrado' at 1920px, so the 'bruto' hint is lost. Widen the field or add a label.
The synthetic 'Comisión pendiente' row has an empty date and sorts first, above the dated rows. Consider sorting it last.

action_items: Add an overpayment guard or warning when a payment's neto exceeds saldoLiquidacion (backend + preview)
Fix comisionPendiente for liquidations fully paid without the discount or via legacy payments (UI cell, synthetic row, PDF line)
Optional: make the commission cap atomic; use the AR timezone for PDF 'Emitido' and the auto commission date; widen the gross-amount input
critical_code_review_comments: routes_rentals.py is 2093 lines; split the liquidaciones/pagos into their own module
_liquidacion_reserva reads r.get('pagosPropietario') directly, while _calc_neto_y_estado uses _pagos_propietario(r) (legacy compat). They should use the same source
pct_aplicado = comision_total/montoEstimado: if extras (ingreso movements) carry commission, the % is inflated relative to the base rent. Make sure this is intended

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional; 2 UX/logic issues

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ properties/reservations (TEST_iter100_*, AAA TEST_UI_iter100); all deleted by id after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with `set -a; . /app/backend/.env; set +a` exported (test_rentals_pago_propietario.py needs MONGO_URL). conftest.py injects the QA admin JWT. _ui_setup_iter100.py setup/cleanup creates a property + confirmed reservation (1,617,000 at 18%) for the UI test of /veraos/liquidaciones.
